eva.grenzzwischenfall.text1: Shots are fired on the border with {nachbar} near {orte, list}; border troops report wounded. Who fired first is unclear: {nachbar} and the Turkish side blame each other.
eva.grenzzwischenfall.warum: Border incidents turn on whether you calm a situation or exploit it. Every reaction is also a signal to the neighbours and to the voters.
eva.grenzzwischenfall.opt.diplomatie.fol: calms the situation, looks weak to hardliners.
eva.grenzzwischenfall.opt.diplomatie.aus: The government lodges a diplomatic protest and offers mediation.
eva.grenzzwischenfall.opt.vergeltung.fol: a show of strength that raises tensions and risks.
eva.grenzzwischenfall.opt.vergeltung.aus: The army responds with a limited counter-strike.
eva.grenzzwischenfall.standard: Without a clear reaction the unrest in the border towns grows.
eva.eu_angebot.text1: The European Commission offers to modernise the customs union and negotiate visa facilitation if Türkiye makes commitments on the rule of law and the judiciary. Business is pushing for it, the nationalists warn of being patronised.
eva.eu_angebot.warum: Europe is Türkiye's most important export market and source of capital, and in return it demands concessions on the rule of law and the judiciary.
eva.eu_angebot.opt.verhandeln.label: Open negotiations and promise a judicial reform
eva.eu_angebot.opt.verhandeln.folge: exports and capital gain, you owe Brussels a reform.
eva.eu_angebot.opt.verhandeln.ausgang: Türkiye opens the talks and promises a judicial reform.
eva.eu_angebot.opt.teilweise.label: Talk only about trade
eva.eu_angebot.opt.teilweise.folge: a start, without commitments on the rule of law.
eva.eu_angebot.opt.teilweise.ausgang: For now both sides talk only about trade.
eva.eu_angebot.opt.ablehnen.label: Decline
eva.eu_angebot.opt.ablehnen.folge: the nationalist camp applauds, business is disappointed.
eva.eu_angebot.standard: The offer goes unanswered and lapses.
eva.iwf_angebot.text1: With a risk premium of {aufschlag} basis points, {kurs} lira to the dollar and {reserven} bn dollars in net reserves, the International Monetary Fund offers a stand-by arrangement. {wer} weighs it up.
eva.iwf_angebot.text2: Foreign currency at once and two tranches after reviews; in return, conditions: a policy rate of at least {zins} % and a deficit of at most {defizit} % of GDP, checked in three reviews. Whoever breaks the conditions loses the programme — and the trust of the markets.
eva.iwf_angebot.warum: An IMF programme brings foreign currency and the trust of the markets and costs political freedom: the conditions bind interest rates and the deficit, and they mostly hit those who have least.
eva.iwf_angebot.opt.annehmen.label: Accept the stand-by arrangement
eva.iwf_angebot.opt.annehmen.folge: inflow of foreign currency and calmer markets in exchange for conditions (rate ≥ {zins} %, deficit ≤ {defizit} %) over three reviews.
eva.iwf_angebot.opt.annehmen.ausgang: The government signs the stand-by arrangement: foreign currency flows in, the markets calm down — and the conditions start ticking.
eva.iwf_angebot.opt.golf.label: Seek loans from the Gulf
eva.iwf_angebot.opt.golf.folge: money without conditions, but with political strings attached.
eva.iwf_angebot.opt.golf.ausgang: Gulf states provide 4 bn dollars; they expect concessions in return.
eva.iwf_angebot.opt.allein.label: Go it alone
eva.iwf_angebot.opt.allein.folge: no conditions, but no help either.
eva.iwf_angebot.standard: The offer lapses; the markets read it as hesitation.
eva.ratingagentur.text1: {agentur} is putting the country's creditworthiness under review: debt {schulden} % of GDP, inflation {inflation} %. A downgrade would make borrowing more expensive.
eva.ratingagentur.warum: Ratings help decide what the state pays for its debt. They follow investor confidence and shape it at the same time.
eva.ratingagentur.opt.fahrplan.label: Present a reform roadmap
eva.ratingagentur.opt.fahrplan.folge: reassures investors, ties the government's hands.
eva.ratingagentur.opt.fahrplan.ausgang: A multi-year reform roadmap is presented.
eva.ratingagentur.opt.roadshow.label: An investor roadshow
eva.ratingagentur.opt.roadshow.folge: attracts capital, is no substitute for reforms.
eva.ratingagentur.opt.zurueckweisen.folg: popular at home, expensive on the markets.
eva.ratingagentur.opt.zurueckweisen.ausg: The government rejects the criticism as unjustified.
eva.ratingagentur.standard: The agency downgrades the country; borrowing becomes more expensive.
eva.nato_ratifizierung.text1: {land|anfang} has applied to join NATO; the members must ratify its accession, and Ankara has a vote. {lage}
eva.nato_ratifizierung.text2: Washington and Brussels are pressing for approval; Ankara can give it or withhold it and demand concessions in return.
eva.nato_ratifizierung.warum: Whoever has a veto has a price. The question is whether you want to be paid in weapons, in commitments or in trust.
eva.nato_ratifizierung.opt.zustimmen.lab: Approve, in exchange for commitments on arms and counter-terrorism
eva.nato_ratifizierung.opt.zustimmen.fol: the West is grateful, Moscow grimaces.
eva.nato_ratifizierung.opt.zustimmen.aus: Türkiye approves and receives commitments on arms and counter-terrorism.
eva.nato_ratifizierung.opt.blockieren.la: Block it until the conditions are met
eva.nato_ratifizierung.opt.blockieren.au: Türkiye blocks ratification of the accession of {land}.
eva.nato_ratifizierung.opt.zeit.label: Play for time
eva.nato_ratifizierung.opt.zeit.folge: keeps all options open and frays nerves.
eva.nato_ratifizierung.standard: The decision is postponed; the allies grow impatient.
eva.gasvertrag.titel: The gas contract with {land} is expiring
eva.gasvertrag.text1: The long-term natural gas supply contract with suppliers from {land} is up for renewal. Energy prices stand at index {preise}, import dependence at {importe}.
eva.gasvertrag.warum: Gas contracts bind for years. A low price is a dependence, and every alternative costs more at first.
eva.gasvertrag.opt.verlaengern.label: Extend it long-term
eva.gasvertrag.opt.diversifizieren.label: Develop new suppliers and liquefied gas
eva.gasvertrag.opt.diversifizieren.folge: more expensive today, more independent tomorrow.
eva.gasvertrag.opt.kurz.label: Extend it only briefly
eva.gasvertrag.opt.kurz.folge: buys a year at a price premium; then the contract is back on the table.
eva.gasvertrag.standard: The contract expires; emergency purchases on the spot market make energy more expensive.
eva.gasfund.text1: A significant gas field has been found in the Black Sea. Production would take years, but it promises fewer imports and new revenue.
eva.gasfund.warum: Resource finds are a gift and a temptation: they can replace imports, pay down debt or fizzle out in subsidies.
eva.gasfund.opt.foerdern.label: Develop it quickly
eva.gasfund.opt.foerdern.folge: fewer imports, a heavier climate burden.
eva.gasfund.opt.fonds.folge: revenue for the coming years, little for today.
eva.gasfund.opt.senken.label: Cut energy prices immediately
eva.gasfund.opt.senken.ausgang: The government cuts energy prices for households.
eva.gasfund.standard: The field is surveyed; no decision is taken.
eva.cyberangriff.text1: For hours, an attack paralyses {ziel}. Its origin is unclear; the security agencies speak of a professional operation.
eva.cyberangriff.warum: Digital infrastructure is as vulnerable as it is poorly protected. The weak point often lies not in the technology but in who is responsible.
eva.cyberangriff.opt.beschuldigen.label: Publicly accuse a state
eva.cyberangriff.opt.beschuldigen.folge: the country rallies together, the evidence remains thin.
eva.cyberangriff.opt.beschuldigen.ausgan: The government publicly blames a state.
eva.cyberangriff.opt.still.label: Fix it quietly
eva.cyberangriff.opt.still.ausgang: The systems are repaired without a public statement.
eva.cyberangriff.standard: The authorities stay silent; mistrust grows.
eva.weltwirtschaftskrise.titel: A global economic crisis reaches Türkiye
eva.weltwirtschaftskrise.text1: A slump on world markets drags down demand for Turkish goods: orders are cancelled, tourists stay away, foreign capital pulls out. Growth stands at {wachstum} %, the risk premium rises to {aufschlag} basis points.
eva.weltwirtschaftskrise.text2: {wer} asks whether the state should support the economy or save. Whoever has put capital aside can act now.
eva.weltwirtschaftskrise.warum: Crises come from outside and hit those with the smallest buffers. A state that builds up capital and trust in good years has room to act in bad ones.
supports demand and employment, costs debt.
A stimulus programme supports the economy.
Short-time work and loans for businesses
keeps jobs without blowing the budget.
Short-time work allowances and loan guarantees cushion the blow.
eva.weltwirtschaftskrise.opt.sparen.labe: Stay calm and protect the budget
eva.weltwirtschaftskrise.opt.sparen.folg: the markets are grateful, businesses have to get through on their own.
eva.weltwirtschaftskrise.opt.sparen.ausg: The government holds the budget steady and lets the crisis run its course.
eva.weltwirtschaftskrise.standard: Without a response the crisis deepens; layoffs mount.
eva.pandemie.text1: A new pathogen is spreading faster than any winter infection: hospitals report overload, schools close, flights are cancelled. Health care stands at index {index}.
eva.pandemie.text2: The medical association demands measures; business warns against a standstill.
eva.pandemie.warum: Epidemics show how resilient a health system and a state are. Restrictions protect lives and cost economic output; you cannot maximise both at once.
eva.pandemie.opt.beschraenken.label: Strict restrictions and a vaccination programme
eva.pandemie.opt.beschraenken.folge: protects lives, costs economic output and patience.
eva.pandemie.opt.beschraenken.ausgang: Restrictions and a vaccination programme contain the spread.
eva.pandemie.opt.gezielt.label: Targeted protection: risk groups and hospitals
eva.pandemie.opt.gezielt.ausgang: Risk groups and hospitals receive targeted protection.
eva.pandemie.opt.offen.label: Keep the country open
eva.pandemie.opt.offen.folge: the economy keeps running, the health system reaches its limits.
eva.pandemie.opt.offen.ausgang: The government keeps the country open; the hospitals fill up.
eva.pandemie.standard: Without a clear line the epidemic spreads; trust declines.
eva.cyberangriff.ziel.0: the payment systems of several banks and a power substation
eva.cyberangriff.ziel.1: the network of a major electricity supplier and the railway's ticketing systems
eva.cyberangriff.ziel.2: check-in at two airports and parts of the mobile network
eva.cyberangriff.ziel.3: the data centres of a hospital chain and the tax authority
eva.nato_ratifizierung.bewerber.0.lage: Voting for its admission in the middle of the war would mean openly confronting Russia.
eva.nato_ratifizierung.bewerber.1.lage: A Black Sea neighbour with Russian troops on part of its territory.
eva.nato_ratifizierung.bewerber.2.lage: A small country with a breakaway region under Russian influence.
eva.nato_ratifizierung.bewerber.3.lage: Deeply divided at home; Ankara has its own interests and friends there.
